programme.sub-title: The Sam In The Grey Flannel Suit

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody and Sam want a raise, but the bar's takings have been declining for three months.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla's depressed when she learns she's going to be a grandmother.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and his Cheers gang have lost 173 sporting competitions to their rival, Gary and Gary's Old Town Tavern.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Woody make a bet that they can kiss Rebecca before midnight.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca finds out Evan is moving to Tokyo and bringing another woman along.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Lillian Corporation's new vice president fires Rebecca and rehires Sam as the bar's revival manager.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam vows to be abstinent when he finds out he may have fathered a child.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam traps Rebecca into declaring that she's in love with her boss.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca pretends she's engaged to Sam when the bar owner proposes.
programme.sub-title: One Happy Chappy In A Snappy Serape

programme.title: South Park: Le Problème Chinois
programme.desc: Cartman développe une véritable paranoïa envers les chinois à cause du cauchemar qui hante ses nuits depuis peu : la cérémonie d'ouverture des JO de Pékin.

programme.title: South Park: Le Combat
programme.desc: Wendy s'attire des ennuis en menaçant Cartman de le frapper après l'école. Peu importe la rage de Wendy, tous les paris donnent Cartman gagnant.

programme.title: South Park: Pandémie
programme.desc: Les enfants remarquent l'incroyable prolifération de musiciens péruviens dans les centres commerciaux.

programme.title: South Park: Pandémie 2 - La Terreur
programme.desc: Les enfants et Craig se retrouvent paumés dans la jungle péruvienne. Depuis le renvoi des musiciens péruviens, les États-Unis sont attaqués par des cochons d'Inde géants que Randy filme en pleine panique avec sa nouvelle caméra.

programme.title: South Park: À propos d'hier soir
programme.desc: Barack Obama vient de remporter les élections présidentielles face à McCain. Tout le pays est divisé entre les gagnants, dont Randy, qui font la fête ; et les perdants, dont Ike, qui sont persuadés que la fin du monde est proche.

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Les garçons se rendent compte qu'ils ne sont plus les plus cools de l'école. Stan réalise qu'il pourrait perdre Wendy s'il ne change rien à cette situation !

programme.title: South Park: L'Impunissable
programme.desc: Les enfants Goth de l'école élémentaire de South Park ont de la concurrence. Butters est persuadé d'avoir vu un vampire à l'école, mais personne ne l'écoute.

programme.title: South Park: La Bague
programme.desc: Kenny emmène sa petite amie à un concert des Jonas Brothers, pensant que celui-ci le mènera à son cœur et à d'autres parties du corps.

programme.title: South Park: Le Coon
programme.desc: Persuadé que la ville de South Park a besoin d'un super-héros, Cartman devient, la nuit venue, Le Coon.

programme.title: South Park: Margaritaville
programme.desc: Randy annonce qu'il a une solution pour sortir le pays de son désastre économique.

programme.title: South Park: Mange, prie et froute
programme.desc: Les enfants sont surexcités car en rentrant chez eux ils verront la suite d'un épisode de Terrence et Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Bite au nez de poisson
programme.desc: Jimmy en veut à Cartman de s'attribuer le mérite d'une blague qu'il a lui-même créée et qui a beaucoup de succès dans tout le pays. Mais Kanye West est très énervé car il n'en comprend pas la chute.

programme.title: South Park: Le Derby de Pinewood
programme.desc: Stan participe avec son père Randy à une course de petites voitures en bois, le Derby de Pinewood.

programme.title: South Park: Barbobèse
programme.desc: Butters et un petit groupe de recrues rejoignent Cartman dans son rêve de vivre sur l'île du crâne où se trouve un trésor enterré.

programme.title: South Park: Vedettes mortes
programme.desc: Des fantômes de célébrités récemment décédées tourmentent Ike. Il est mort de peur et le stress pourrait bien le tuer.

programme.title: South Park: La Meilleure Gagneuse de Butters
programme.desc: Butters découvre une activité lucrative après avoir pour la première fois fait payer un baiser. Mais le sergent Yates décide de lutter très activement contre la prostitution.

programme.title: South Park: Catch
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent leur nouvelle passion dans la vie après être allés à un combat de catch et se dépêchent de signer pour le club de lutte.

programme.title: South Park: Putain de baleines
programme.desc: Stan fête son anniversaire avec sa famille à l'aquarium de Denver où ils vont pouvoir nager avec les dauphins.

programme.title: South Park: Fiottes
programme.desc: Les enfants vont se battre pour que le festival Harley ne ruine pas leur week-end à South Park !

programme.title: South Park: Danse avec les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: Cartman prend le contrôle des annonces du matin à l'école. Grâce à cela, il veut devenir la voix du changement !

programme.title: South Park: Pipi
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman, Kyle, Kenny, Butters et Jimmy se rendent au parc aquatique pour une journée pleine de fun. Malheureusement, les choses se passent autrement et ils ont rendez-vous avec la mort.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous les grands scientifiques des Etats-Unis se réunissent pour plancher sur une épidémie étrange: l'addiction au sexe. Il semblerait que les hommes riches et puissants veulent soudainement coucher avec des tonnes de femmes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après avoir lu le livre controversé de J.D. Salinger, 'L'Attrape-cœurs' Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny se lancent à leur tour dans l'écriture d'un roman. Mais la mère de Stan découvre leur prose.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le restaurant préféré de Cartman a fermé et laissé place à une pharmacie qui vend du cannabis médicinal. Randy essaie alors désespérément d'obtenir une prescription médicale pour pouvoir s'en procurer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent Facebook et les relations entre 'amis' virtuels. Malheureusement pour lui, Kyle accepte de devenir ami avec la mauvaise personne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet été, l'heure n'est pas à la détente mais à la compétition. Jimmy et ses amis handicapés mettent tout en oeuvre pour être les champions du camp de vacances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman rêve de devenir pilote de Nascar et est prêt à tout pour y parvenir. Comme il est persuadé qu'il faut être pauvre et stupide pour exceller dans cette discipline, il va tenter de se débarrasser de tout son argent et de ses neurones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour lutter contre l'invasion des habitants de New Jersey, la ville de South Park se mobilise et en vient à faire appel à Oussama Ben Laden.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: À la demande de Wendy Testaburger, Stan accepte de ranger son casier avec l'aide d'un groupe de 'spécialistes'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Emmenés par Mystérion, les super-héros doivent résoudre la crise du Golfe et arrêter Cthulhu. Mais le Coon a d'autres idées en tête.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon se révèle être plus infâme encore que le Seigneur maléfique Cthulhu! Alors que le Coon punit ses anciens amis, Kenny tente de vivre avec le fardeau que représente son super-pouvoir.
programme.sub-title: Le Coon contre le Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est la pagaille dans la vie de Stan, à la maison comme à l'école, à cause de l'obsession de Randy pour les chaînes culinaires. Et cela affecte même Sharon qui, se sentant délaissée, décide de faire du sport.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La princesse canadienne est kidnappée pendant sa cérémonie de mariage, Ike est convoqué au Canada pour aider à la retrouver. Qui peut bien être l'auteur d'un tel crime?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles, Chopper unleashes his inner beast, and Luffy inches ever closer to catching up with Robin!
programme.sub-title: Bubble master kalifa! The soap trap closes in on nami!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky has a painful encounter with monster Chopper, and Nami gets scrubbed too clean to fight! Meanwhile, Spandam accidentally invokes the deadly Buster Call!
programme.sub-title: Resounding bad news! Buster call invoked!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his battle with the beasts, and Nami discovers the secret that could be the key to survival in her brawl with the bathing beauty!
programme.sub-title: Five namis? Nami strikes back with mirages!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Nami come up with a plan to stop Chopper’s rampage, but it could prove deadly to the not-so-little reindeer. Usopp and Zoro are thrilled to finally be free of each other!
programme.sub-title: Nami's decision! Fire at the out-of-control chopper!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp’s ill-advised attempt at bravery threatens to get him killed, but a familiar foot spares the sniper’s life. Luffy struggles to even strike a formidable foe, and Franky races to deliver some very important keys!
programme.sub-title: Hunter sanji makes an entrance? Elegy for a lying wolf!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji evens the playing field in his CP9 slugfest by introducing his wolfish opponent to the burning power of the devil’s leg!
programme.sub-title: Fiery kicks! Sanji's full course of foot techniques!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finally lands a blow against the killer giraffe, but Luffy still can’t find a way to break through against Lucci! Can Frank reach Robin before it’s too late!?
programme.sub-title: Fierce sword attacks! Zoro vs. Kaku, powerful sword fighting showdown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro unleashes a demonic nine sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent, Luffy buys time for Franky by ascending to second gear, and Robin refuses to give up hope of being rescued!
programme.sub-title: Demon god zoro! An incarnation of asura born from fighting spirit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Spandam cruely drags Robin ever closer to the gates of justice, but the battle takes a turn for the better when the Sniper King makes a surprise appearance!
programme.sub-title: Spandam frightened! The hero on the tower of law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man’s second gear, and the Spandam’s thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannonballs.
programme.sub-title: Robin freed! Luffy vs. Lucci, showdown between leaders!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village’s annual festival!
programme.sub-title: Boss luffy is the culprit? Track down the missing great cherry tree!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in a tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.
programme.sub-title: I can't protect anyone unless i win! Third gear activated!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy’s battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.
programme.sub-title: Shivering past! Dark justice and rob lucci!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!
programme.sub-title: A mysterious mermaid appears? As consciousness fades away…

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!
programme.sub-title: Cannon fire sinks the island! Franky's lamentation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns – if he ever does.
programme.sub-title: Wait for luffy! Mortal combat on the bridge of hesitation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp’s desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!
programme.sub-title: Fists full of emotion! Luffy unleashes gatling with all his might!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!
programme.sub-title: From the sea, a friend arrives! The straw hats share the strongest bond!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they’ll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!
programme.sub-title: Everyone makes a great escape! The road to victory is for the pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats bid a tearful farewell to the brave little ship that was their home for so very many adventures. Rest in peace, Merry!
programme.sub-title: Thank you, merry! Snow falls over the parting sea!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!
programme.sub-title: Peace interrupted! A navy vice admiral with a fist of love!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that’s nothing compared to how surprised they’ll be by his father’s true identity!
programme.sub-title: The strongest family? Luffy's father revealed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.
programme.sub-title: Its name is the new world! The fate of the grand line!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request, Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship for the Straw Hats, and news spreads of the events at Enies Lobby.
programme.sub-title: Shanks makes a move! The linchpin to the reckless era!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!
programme.sub-title: A girl in search of her yagara! Great search in the city of water!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro’s day takes a turn for the crazy when his search for a new sword is derailed by a couple of meddling orphans!
programme.sub-title: Mothers are strong! Zoro's hectic household chores!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji spends the day with a very old chef who teaches him the secret of packing amazing flavor into each and every dish!
programme.sub-title: Sanji's shock! Mysterious old man and his super yummy cooking!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Iceberg stay up all night on a mission to finish a new ship for the Straw Hats, but the first light of day brings troubling news!
programme.sub-title: Everyone finally has a bounty! A pirate group worth over 600 million!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With their new ship completed, Luffy and the gang get ready to set sail, but first, they’ll have to steal some underpants in order to secure the services of a shipwright!
programme.sub-title: The king of animals that overlooks the sea! The dream ship magnificently completed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A series of flashbacks to his younger days – and some painful persuasion by Robin – help Franky make the difficult decision to leave his friends and go to sea with the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: Goodbye my dear underlings! Franky departs!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats are ready for their next adventure, but before they can move on they must await the return of Usopp – and avoid a barrage of cannonballs courtesy of Garp!
programme.sub-title: Departing the city of water! Usopp mans up and brings closure to the duel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats’ new ship gets a name, and Franky shows off some of its special features as the gang goes sky high to avoid being sunk by the marines!
programme.sub-title: Wanted posters make it around the world! Celebration in their hometowns as the ship moves forward!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace and Blackbeard go toe-to-toe in an epic clash of Devil Fruit powers that pits fire against darkness – and threatens to destroy an entire island!
programme.sub-title: The most heinous power! Blackbeard's darkness attacks ace!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates cross paths with a ragged gang of sailors. The Straw Hats are quick to offer assistance, but their new friends may be up to no good!
programme.sub-title: The Mysterious Band of Pirates! Sunny and the Dangerous Trap!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats discover that their fishermen friends are actually pirates, but Chopper refuses to abandon a very sick patient.
programme.sub-title: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny is so excited – it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-carts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited 'cause this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the Shoe Shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots -- these are bouncy boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ballplayers. A long time ago in a Mayan Kingdom, there was a big Ball Game Championship.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the Piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!
programme.sub-title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's naptime for the twins and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big Pirate Treasure Hunt, but his Piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates -- yay!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas falls down on Boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Super Babies!: It's the Twins' 1st birthday and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a Cake-snatching Bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his Grandma's House! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
programme.sub-title: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land where it breaks!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge. When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Mikey Gets Shellacne: Michelangelo is tired of being the "runt of the litter." But when he fools around with some mutagen, he gets a dangerous infection that is mutating out of control.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Target: April O'Neil: April tries to resume a normal teenage life, but when Karai starts hunting her again, April realizes she may have put her new friend Casey Jones in danger as well.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Slash and Destroy: The Turtles find themselves being hunted by a new threat—another mutant turtle called Slash, who has a personal vendetta against the brothers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Kraang Conspiracy: Feeling left out of the action, April insists on joining the Turtles on a mission to TCRI, where they learn a shocking secret about April's past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Good, The Bad and, Casey Jones: After encountering mutants and ninjas, Casey Jones decides to take on "pure evil" alone. When he meets Raphael, the two fighters must put their dislike for each other aside and work together against a common foe.
programme.sub-title: The Good, The Bad, and Casey Jones

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fungus Humungous: A fungus mutant spreading through the sewers causes the Turtles and April to experience their worst fears as Leonardo must face his greatest fear—losing his team.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Metalhead Rewired: When Donnie upgrades Metalhead's artificial intelligence, he must decide if he can trust a sentient Metalhead… or if he has created a new foe.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Of Rats and Men: When the Rat King returns, Splinter must overcome his guilt and fear of the Rat King controlling his mind in order to defeat his foe once and for all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Mazes & Mutants: The Turtles try to relax by playing a fantasy role-playing game, but when the game becomes real, they must learn the difference between fantasy and reality.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Lonely Mutation of Baxter Stockman: Feeling guilty for turning April's father into a mutant bat, the Turtles perfect a retro-mutagen to help him. Unfortunately, things get worse when Baxter Stockman threatens to mutate April.
programme.sub-title: The Lonely Mutation of Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Newtralized!: Raph is worried about Casey's ability to handle big mutant threats…when they meet Slash again and discover he has a partner of his own: THE NEWTRALIZER!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Wrath of Tiger Claw: Tiger Claw returns and intends to destroy the Turtles at any cost.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Pizza Face: Mikey discovers that a new mutant is trying to attack and capture people using living pizzas, but he struggles to convince the others who don't believe him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Legend of the Kuro Kabuto: Leo, worried about Karai, tries to convince the others to rescue her, while a master thief steals Shredder's helmet, and it falls into the Turtles' unsuspecting hands.
programme.sub-title: The Legend of the Kuro Kabuto

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Plan 10: Raph's hot-headed impulsiveness lands him in deep trouble when he accidentally damages a machine that forces him to switch minds with a Kraang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Vengeance is Mine: Leo goes behind Splinter's back when he stages a rescue for Karai, whose desire for revenge against Shredder brings about grave consequences for them all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: A Chinatown Ghost Story: As Donnie becomes increasingly jealous of April and Casey's relationship, April is kidnapped by an evil spirit who intends to drain April's powers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Into Dimension X!: At home, Mikey always messes things up, but when the Turtles go to the bizarre realm of Dimension X, he's the only one who can figure the place out.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.desc: Buster learns that special effects can't take the place of hard work when conquering real mountains. Arthur is thrilled to find out that Sitting Bull once passed through town! He rallies the residents to mark the spot with a monument.

programme.desc: Muffy wants a Bouncy Castle at her party, but when her favorite cherry tree is cut down to make room for it, she starts to have regrets. Francine and Muffy scheme to set up their older siblings Chip and Catherine, but plans go awry.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Horrific allegations are tearing a family apart. Todd, ex girlfriend Latia & mom Diana tell their versions of sexual misconduct. Todd says he will do anything to prove his innocence. Dr. Phil calls in a polygraph examiner, with shocking results.
programme.sub-title: A Father Accused: Who's Telling The Truth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you ignoring warning signs in your relationship? Is there something concerning you that you haven't addressed? Dr. Phil warns his viewers: Don't think your problems will go away once you walk down the aisle, face the issues now before it's too late!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bob says his wife of 23 years, Dorothy, accuses him of cheating despite his denial. He says Dorothy has clawed his face, smashed windows & threatened to cut off his manhood, convinced he's been unfaithful. What does Bob say is the cause of her mistrust?
programme.sub-title: A Lying, Cheating, Violent Husband Or A Wife's False Accusations?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lovie says a viral video of her son Darnell shows him attacking his girlfriend & dragging her. Darnell says he doesn't recognize himself & he wants to apologize to the world. Brianna says the attack was one of three beatings her sister endured that night.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracey says her 23-year marriage is falling apart because husband Doug is having an affair with transgender female Essence. Tracey wants Doug to choose once and for all so that she can move on with her life. Why is she leaving the decision to him?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussion with exes Michael and Susan, as well as Susan’s new husband, Cory, about the care of 11-year-old Bodhi, who Susan insists is experiencing schizophrenia, just like Michael and Susan’s 16-year-old daughter, Janni. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Second Schizophrenic Child Or A Misdiagnosing Mom: Can Bodhi Be Helped Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Emotions run high when Kim’s sisters meet boyfriend Stacy for the first time and Dr. Phil reveals a shocking secret from Stacy’s past. What explanation does Stacy offer? How much did Kim know? Plus, Dr. Phil's advice for the family moving forward. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Sister Intervention: The Boyfriend's Sordid Past Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pregnancy is a time of baby showers, nesting, indulging food cravings and being pampered. But Dr. Phil’s guests, Shayna, says she's been pregnant more than a year, and Zona, says she's been pregnant over 3 1/2 years, Both are looking for answers why.
programme.sub-title: A Woman Claims To Be Pregnant For 3 Years 7 Months

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s an emotional story that has captivated viewers for years. John Clark’s search for his three children abducted by their mother concludes when John received news that his children were found and living in London. John reunites with his children. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: John says his ex-wife, Laurie, abandoned their children. John admits his boys disrespect his authority, with one son punching him in the face. As Laurie denies deserting her children, we hear from the three boys: is it clueless parenting or unruly kids?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel says he and Lynsey are in a custody battle filled with lies and accusations and daughter Sophie, 4, is caught in the middle. Lynsey says after a visit with Daniel their daughter came home saying he hurt her. Dr. Phil sifts through the chaos. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Compulsive Lies, False Charges, & Coaching: A Dad's Fears About His Daughter's Safety At Mom's House Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Crystal accuses her ex-boyfriend, Anthony, of sexually assaulting their 3-year-old daughter. Crystal says she has proof confirming Anthony as the monster she says he is. Anthony says Crystal is “crazy and a liar.” Can Dr. Phil expose the truth? Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Lies, Child Sex Abuse, And Stalking Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Courtney claims her former friend Amie has lied about being pregnant three times and losing five babies total. To uncover the truth, Dr. Phil producers spoke with the county coroner, the hospital, and tracked down one of the supposed fathers-to-be. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accused Of Faking Multiple Pregnancies And Baby Deaths: Is She Scamming Men Or A Victim Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping two-part series, Dr. Phil sits down with a family torn apart over accusations of the unthinkable. Melody says her 4-year-old granddaughter revealed that she was touched inappropriately by a man in a mask, and that the man was her daddy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather's son, Brandon, 15, died of an accidental overdose at her home; authorities say the teen swallowed & snorted Heather's morphine pills while drinking vodka and beer. Acquitted of charges, Heather says her ex-husband Brian continues to blame her.
programme.sub-title: Acquitted By A Jury But My Ex-Husband Still Thinks I'm Guilty Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview
